lines.zh: 步伐沉重，拖着一条断腿。
四处搜寻食物，目光凶狠。
咬向附近的腐肉，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Bites nearby rotting flesh, showing sharp teeth.
Nods head to find fallen bones.

lines.zh: 舔舐伤口，流出暗红色的血液。
lines.en: Licks wound, leaving dark red blood.
Gnaws on a rotting animal corpse.

lines.zh: 低头嗅探地面，寻找食物。
寻找机会攻击附近的幸存者。
lines.en: Seeks opportunity to attack nearby survivors.

lines.zh: 它忽然加速，几步就贴近
lines.en: It suddenly sprints and closes in a few steps.
Limping on a broken leg, it still runs.
leans against wall, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 注视着进入视野的玩家。
lines.en: stares at player entering its sight.

lines.zh: 啃咬自己的断腿，发出痛苦的声音。
lines.en: gnaws on broken leg, emitting painful sounds.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，似乎在回忆过去。
lines.en: nods head in thought, seemingly recalling past.

lines.zh: 舔舐流血的伤口，努力生存。
lines.en: licks bleeding wound, struggling to survive.
nods head to eat fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 环顾四周，寻找食物来源。
lines.en: looks around, searching for food sources.

lines.zh: 舔舐同伴的尸体，搜刮资源。
lines.en: licks companion corpse, scavenging for resources.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，流露出凶狠目光。
突然注意到玩家，朝向玩家方向。
张开嘴，露出锋利的牙齿。
目光紧锁玩家，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: stares intently at player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 伸出一只手，似乎要抓住玩家。
lines.en: reaches out a hand, as if to grab player.

lines.zh: 喉咙发出咕噜声，渴望捕食。
lines.en: makes a gurgling sound, hungry to hunt.

lines.zh: 舔舐流血的手指，沾满鲜血。
lines.en: licks bleeding fingers, covered in blood.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，警告玩家远离。
lines.en: hisses warning at player to stay away.

lines.zh: 紧紧盯着玩家，眼神充满贪婪。
lines.en: stares intensely at player, eyes filled with greed.
Look at me. You can't escape.
Clench your teeth. Feel my bite.

lines.zh: 别想跑，我已经闻到你了。
lines.en: Don't try to run, I smell you.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻，你将不再是你。
lines.en: Enjoy this moment, you won't be you.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我看到你的恐惧。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see your fear.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包，比你先走。
lines.en: That bread in your hand goes before you do.
Avoid me, or you'll get hurt.
I'm lucky to collide with you.
Collide with you, you can't escape.
Be careful, I won't spare you.

lines.zh: 你挡住我这条断腿的尸，找死。
lines.en: You block a corpse with a broken leg. Bad choice.
You deserved to collide with me.
Collide with you, and I'll bite you.
Mate with you, I won't give up.

lines.zh: 与你交配，这是命中注定。

lines.en: Mate with you, I'm not alone.

lines.zh: 跟我走，我们一起烂下去。
lines.en: Come with me; we'll rot on together.
Mate with you, I have a goal.
Mate with you, you'll join me.
Found you, mating is the only way.
Mate with you, I won't stop.

lines.zh: 干枯的皮肤在风中摇曳
lines.en: Dry skin sways in the breeze

lines.zh: 伤口在流血，痛苦无法平息
我身上的味道，连自己也受不了。
lines.en: Even I can't stand my own stench.
Leg broken, but I won't give up

lines.zh: 寒冷的夜晚，我更显可怕
lines.en: Cold night, I loom more sinister

lines.zh: 地上这块肉，先归我的嘴。
lines.en: That meat on the ground belongs to my mouth first.
It locks on, its breath turning ragged.
It vaults over the low wall.
A pale face turns your way.
It drops to all fours and speeds up.
Fresh blood in wounds draws me
It skids to a halt ten paces away and gathers itself.

lines.zh: 它左右晃动，找你的空隙
lines.en: It sways side to side, hunting a gap.
Claws rake the ground, leaving long marks.

lines.zh: 它绕着你跑，不让你瞄准
lines.en: It runs circles so you cannot aim.

lines.zh: 它喉咙里的嘶声越来越急
lines.en: The hiss in its throat quickens.

lines.zh: 一个踉跄，它又扑了上来
它贴地冲来，几乎看不清
lines.en: It streaks low, almost too fast to see.

lines.zh: 它在等你收回手的瞬间
lines.en: It waits for the instant you pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 我的指甲陷进你的肩膀里！
lines.en: My nails sink into your shoulder!
It tackles you and bites wildly.
A claw rips your sleeve open.

lines.zh: 它撞在你胸口，把你顶翻
lines.en: It slams your chest and flips you over.
It bites your foot and drags you back.
It drives its forehead into your face.
Blood runs into its eyes and it keeps biting.

lines.zh: 一阵急促的脚步由远及近
lines.en: Rapid footsteps come closer and closer.
It bursts out at the end of the alley.

lines.zh: 尸体堆里，一个猛地弹起
lines.en: One jerks upright from the pile of bodies.
It smashes the wooden door and bursts in.

lines.zh: 咒光烫在我烂肉上，冒烟。
lines.en: Spell-light burns my rotting flesh and it smokes.

lines.zh: 饿得我眼前发黑，站不住。
lines.en: Hunger blacks my sight; I can't stand straight.
